lines.raw: What is CCLF?
lines.say: What is C C L F?

lines.raw: CCLF.
lines.say: C C L F.

lines.raw: **Claim and Claim Line Feed**.
lines.say: Claim and Claim Line Feed.

lines.raw: A set of files CMS sends **monthly** to participating ACOs (and some other CMS programmes), with Medicare claims and beneficiary details for their assigned or aligned beneficiaries.
lines.say: A set of files C M S sends monthly to participating A C O's (and some other C M S programmes), with Medicare claims and beneficiary details for their assigned or aligned beneficiaries.

lines.raw: Feed.
lines.say: Feed.

lines.raw: Data that arrives again and again on a schedule, like a newspaper delivered every morning.
lines.say: Data that arrives again and again on a schedule, like a newspaper delivered every morning.

lines.raw: Claim header vs claim line.
lines.say: Claim header versus claim line.

lines.raw: The **header** holds facts about the whole claim (dates, patient, provider, principal diagnosis); each **line** is one item (one revenue center or one service).
lines.say: The header holds facts about the whole claim (dates, patient, provider, principal diagnosis); each line is one item (one revenue center or one service).

lines.raw: The Medical course covers this in more detail.
lines.say: The Medical course covers this in more detail.

lines.raw: Think of a monthly ledger book from the cooperative.
lines.say: Think of a monthly ledger book from the cooperative.

lines.raw: Imagine your local cooperative (sahakari) posts you a bundle every month: one sheet listing each loan, a second sheet with the line items of each loan, a third sheet with member details, and a cover note saying how many rows are on each sheet.
lines.say: Imagine your local cooperative (sahakari) posts you a bundle every month: one sheet listing each loan, a second sheet with the line items of each loan, a third sheet with member details, and a cover note saying how many rows are on each sheet.

lines.raw: CCLF is that bundle.
lines.say: C C L F is that bundle.

lines.raw: Each sheet is a separate **file**, and you match them using the **loan number**, which in CCLF is the claim ID.
lines.say: Each sheet is a separate file, and you match them using the loan number, which in C C L F is the claim I D.

lines.raw: The CCLF file set.
lines.say: The C C L F file set.

lines.raw: CMS splits the claims by kind.
lines.say: C M S splits the claims by kind.

lines.raw: The **"Part A"** files hold **institutional** claims (bills from hospitals, nursing facilities, home health and hospice, sent on the UB-04 / 837I format).
lines.say: The "Part A" files hold institutional claims (bills from hospitals, nursing facilities, home health and hospice, sent on the U B 04 or 8 3 7 I format).

lines.raw: The **"Part B"** files hold **professional** claims (doctors) and **DME** (equipment and supplies).
lines.say: The "Part B" files hold professional claims (doctors) and D M E (equipment and supplies).

lines.raw: Part D holds prescription drug events.
lines.say: Part D holds prescription drug events.

lines.raw: Main CCLF files (names as in CMS's CCLF documentation).
lines.say: Main C C L F files (names as in CMS's C C L F documentation).

lines.raw: **CCLF1**. Name: Part A Claims Header. One row means: One institutional claim (header). Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, `BENE_MBI_ID`, `CLM_TYPE_CD`, `CLM_FROM_DT`, `CLM_THRU_DT`, `PRNCPL_DGNS_CD`, `CLM_PMT_AMT`.
lines.say: C C L F 1. Name: Part A Claims Header. One row means: One institutional claim (header). Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, BENE_MBI_ID, CLM_TYPE_CD, CLM_FROM_DT, CLM_THRU_DT, PRNCPL_DGNS_CD, CLM_PMT_AMT.

lines.raw: **CCLF2**. Name: Part A Claims Revenue Center Detail. One row means: One revenue center line on an institutional claim. Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, `CLM_LINE_NUM`, `CLM_LINE_PROD_REV_CTR_CD`, `CLM_LINE_HCPCS_CD`.
lines.say: C C L F 2. Name: Part A Claims Revenue Center Detail. One row means: One revenue center line on an institutional claim. Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, CLM_LINE_NUM, CLM_LINE_PROD_REV_CTR_CD, CLM_LINE_HCPCS_CD.

lines.raw: **CCLF3**. Name: Part A Procedure Code. One row means: One ICD-10-PCS procedure on an institutional claim. Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, procedure code, procedure date.
lines.say: C C L F 3. Name: Part A Procedure Code. One row means: One I C D 10-PCS procedure on an institutional claim. Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, procedure code, procedure date.

lines.raw: **CCLF4**. Name: Part A Diagnosis Code. One row means: One ICD-10-CM diagnosis on an institutional claim. Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, `CLM_DGNS_CD`, `CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM` (its order).
lines.say: C C L F 4. Name: Part A Diagnosis Code. One row means: One I C D 10-CM diagnosis on an institutional claim. Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, CLM_DGNS_CD, CLM_VAL_SQNC_NUM (its order).

lines.raw: **CCLF5**. Name: Part B Physicians. One row means: One line on a professional (doctor) claim. Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, `CLM_LINE_NUM`, `CLM_LINE_HCPCS_CD`, `RNDRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM`, diagnosis codes.
lines.say: C C L F 5. Name: Part B Physicians. One row means: One line on a professional (doctor) claim. Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, CLM_LINE_NUM, CLM_LINE_HCPCS_CD, RNDRG_PRVDR_NPI_NUM, diagnosis codes.

lines.raw: **CCLF6**. Name: Part B DME. One row means: One line on a durable medical equipment claim. Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, `CLM_LINE_HCPCS_CD`, supplier NPI.
lines.say: C C L F 6. Name: Part B D M E. One row means: One line on a durable medical equipment claim. Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, CLM_LINE_HCPCS_CD, supplier N P I.

lines.raw: **CCLF7**. Name: Part D. One row means: One prescription fill (Part D event). Examples of key fields: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID`, `CLM_LINE_NDC_CD`, fill date, days supply.
lines.say: C C L F 7. Name: Part D. One row means: One prescription fill (Part D event). Examples of key fields: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID, CLM_LINE_NDC_CD, fill date, days supply.

lines.raw: **CCLF8**. Name: Beneficiary Demographics. One row means: One beneficiary. Examples of key fields: `BENE_MBI_ID`, `BENE_DOB`, `BENE_SEX_CD`, `BENE_DEATH_DT`, `BENE_MDCR_STUS_CD`.
lines.say: C C L F 8. Name: Beneficiary Demographics. One row means: One beneficiary. Examples of key fields: BENE_MBI_ID, BENE_DOB, BENE_SEX_CD, BENE_DEATH_DT, BENE_MDCR_STUS_CD.

lines.raw: **CCLF9**. Name: Beneficiary XREF (cross-reference). One row means: One link from an old MBI to a new MBI. Examples of key fields: `CRNT_NUM` (current MBI), `PRVS_NUM` (previous MBI) and the dates the old one was valid.
lines.say: C C L F 9. Name: Beneficiary X R E F (cross-reference). One row means: One link from an old M B I to a new M B I. Examples of key fields: CRNT_NUM (current M B I), PRVS_NUM (previous M B I) and the dates the old one was valid.

lines.raw: **CCLF0**. Name: Summary statistics. One row means: One row per file in the delivery. Examples of key fields: File name and **record count**, used to check the load.
lines.say: C C L F 0. Name: Summary statistics. One row means: One row per file in the delivery. Examples of key fields: File name and record count, used to check the load.

lines.raw: Smaller files you may also see.
lines.say: Smaller files you may also see.

lines.raw: CMS also sends **CCLFA** and **CCLFB**, which carry extra codes for Part A and Part B claims linked to special programmes and demonstrations.
lines.say: C M S also sends C C L F A and C C L F B, which carry extra codes for Part A and Part B claims linked to special programmes and demonstrations.

lines.raw: Many beginners can skip them at first.

lines.raw: CMS updates the CCLF layout from time to time, so always work from the **current CCLF Information Packet** for exact field names and positions.
lines.say: C M S updates the C C L F layout from time to time, so always work from the current C C L F Information Packet for exact field names and positions.

lines.raw: The two IDs that hold everything together.
lines.say: The two I D's that hold everything together.

lines.raw: `CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID` (**current claim unique identifier**) links a claim's header to its lines, diagnoses and procedures across CCLF1, 2, 3 and 4.
lines.say: CUR_CLM_UNIQ_ID (current claim unique identifier) links a claim's header to its lines, diagnoses and procedures across C C L F 1, 2, 3 and 4.

lines.raw: `BENE_MBI_ID` links every claim to the person in CCLF8.
lines.say: BENE_MBI_ID links every claim to the person in C C L F 8.

lines.raw: Each claim carries a two-digit **claim type code** saying what kind of bill it is.
lines.say: Each claim carries a two-digit claim type code saying what kind of bill it is.

lines.raw: These come from Medicare's own claim system and are used across many CMS files.
lines.say: These come from Medicare's own claim system and are used across many C M S files.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: `10`. Meaning: Home health agency. CCLF file: CCLF1 to 4 (Part A).
lines.say: 10. Meaning: Home health agency. C C L F file: C C L F 1 to 4 (Part A).

lines.raw: `20`, `30`. Meaning: Skilled nursing facility (30 = "swing bed" in a hospital). CCLF file: CCLF1 to 4 (Part A).
lines.say: 20, 30. Meaning: Skilled nursing facility (30 = "swing bed" in a hospital). C C L F file: C C L F 1 to 4 (Part A).

lines.raw: `40`. Meaning: Hospital **outpatient**. CCLF file: CCLF1 to 4 (Part A files, even though Medicare Part B pays it).
lines.say: 40. Meaning: Hospital outpatient. C C L F file: C C L F 1 to 4 (Part A files, even though Medicare Part B pays it).

lines.raw: `50`. Meaning: Hospice. CCLF file: CCLF1 to 4 (Part A).
lines.say: 50. Meaning: Hospice. C C L F file: C C L F 1 to 4 (Part A).

lines.raw: `60`. Meaning: Hospital **inpatient**. CCLF file: CCLF1 to 4 (Part A).
lines.say: 60. Meaning: Hospital inpatient. C C L F file: C C L F 1 to 4 (Part A).

lines.raw: `71`, `72`. Meaning: Doctor and other professional claims. CCLF file: CCLF5 (Part B Physicians).
lines.say: 71, 72. Meaning: Doctor and other professional claims. C C L F file: C C L F 5 (Part B Physicians).

lines.raw: `81`, `82`. Meaning: Durable medical equipment. CCLF file: CCLF6 (Part B DME).
lines.say: 81, 82. Meaning: Durable medical equipment. C C L F file: C C L F 6 (Part B D M E).

lines.raw: A common trap: "Part A" files are really "institutional" files.
lines.say: A common trap: "Part A" files are really "institutional" files.

lines.raw: Medicare **Part B** pays for hospital **outpatient** visits, but those bills come from a hospital on an institutional claim, so they land in **CCLF1 to 4**, not in CCLF5.
lines.say: Medicare Part B pays for hospital outpatient visits, but those bills come from a hospital on an institutional claim, so they land in C C L F 1 to 4, not in C C L F 5.

lines.raw: If you sum CCLF1 and call it "Part A spending", you will wrongly include outpatient spending.
lines.say: If you sum C C L F 1 and call it "Part A spending", you will wrongly include outpatient spending.

lines.raw: Split by `CLM_TYPE_CD` instead.
lines.say: Split by CLM_TYPE_CD instead.
